description: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines operates direct flights between Amsterdam Schiphol and Paramaribo's Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport. The main European carrier for Suriname, with connections onward to the KLM network across Europe and beyond.

name: Knini Paati
description: Knini Paati River Resort is in the Sipaliwini district, roughly 200 km from Paramaribo, reached by a three-hour drive and a short boat ride. The resort sits on a two-part island in the Ferulasi Sula, a community founded by descendants of escaped slaves. Guests experience Maroon culture, river life and the surrounding interior forest.

name: Kodouffi Tapawatra Resort
description: Kodouffi Tapawatra Resort sits at the confluence of the PikienRio and GranRio rivers in the Surinamese interior. The resort is directly adjacent to Tapawatra Falls, a waterfall exceeding 100 metres, which is visible from the property throughout the stay. Reached by river from Paramaribo, it is a remote destination for travellers exploring the Surinamese interior.

name: Koina Resort
description: A resort on the Afobakaweg at Rama, around kilometre 70 on the road to Brokopondo, with sports and recreation facilities alongside accommodation.

name: Kokkie MiQuisine
description: A personal chef service in Paramaribo, cooking for private events and home dining rather than operating a restaurant.

name: Kombat Sports Suriname
description: A foundation promoting and preserving traditional martial arts in Suriname, running taekwondo and related classes.

name: Kong Nam Snack
description: Kong Nam is a Chinese snack bar in Suriname serving classic Surinamese-Chinese fast food including bami, nasi and chowmein. A local institution for quick, affordable Asian-Surinamese flavours.

name: Krasnapolsky Travel & Tours
description: The travel agency arm of Hotel Krasnapolsky in central Paramaribo, handling tour bookings and travel arrangements.

name: Krioro
description: Krioro is a Surinamese restaurant celebrating traditional Creole cuisine. Known for hearty local dishes rooted in Suriname's Creole food culture.

name: Krioro North
description: Krioro North brings authentic Surinamese Creole cuisine to northern Paramaribo. Serving traditional local dishes in a warm, community-focused setting.

name: Krispy
description: A bubble tea and cold drinks shop on J.D. Gompertstraat in Paramaribo.

name: Kushiyaki The Next Episode
description: Kushiyaki: The Next Episode is a Japanese yakitori and grill bar in Paramaribo serving skewered meats, Japanese small plates and sake. A stylish destination for Japanese-inspired dining.

name: Kwan Tai Restaurant
description: Kwan Tai Restaurant is a well-established Chinese restaurant in Paramaribo offering a broad menu of Chinese and Surinamese-Chinese dishes. Known for authentic flavours and generous portions.

name: Kwan Tai Restaurant 2
description: Kwan Tai Restaurant (2nd location) brings the same beloved Chinese-Surinamese menu to another part of Paramaribo, offering consistent quality and generous portions.

name: Kwatta Carfix
description: A tyre dealer at Kwatta in Paramaribo, trading as the banden supermarket.

name: Kyu Pho Grill
description: Kyu Pho Grill is a Vietnamese-inspired restaurant in Paramaribo specialising in pho, grilled meats and South-East Asian street-food dishes.

name: Ladybug Nursery & Garden Center
description: Ladybug Nursery & Garden Center is a plant shop and garden supply store in Paramaribo stocking ornamental plants, tropical species, garden tools, fertilisers and potting soil. Staff can help with plant selection for home gardens and landscaping projects.

name: Lalla Rookh Museum
description: A museum on Indo-Surinamese history and culture, opened on 5 June 2016 by vice-president Ashwin Adhin to mark 143 years since the first indentured labourers arrived in Suriname.

name: Lamour Restaurant
description: L'Amour Restaurant is a fine-dining spot in Paramaribo serving French-influenced cuisine with Surinamese ingredients and a formal, intimate atmosphere. One of the more upmarket dining options in the capital, suited to special occasions, anniversaries and business dinners where presentation matters.

name: Las Tias
description: Las Tias is a Latin fusion restaurant in Paramaribo serving Colombian and Caribbean-inspired dishes: arepas, empanadas, grilled meats and tropical cocktails. A lively spot for Latin food in the capital, with a social atmosphere and regular events.

name: Lashlift Suriname
description: Lashlift Suriname is a beauty studio in Paramaribo specialising in lash lift treatments, which curl and lift natural lashes without extensions for results lasting six to eight weeks. Body waxing is also available. Suited to clients looking for low-maintenance beauty treatments.

name: Le Den
description: Le Den is a cosy bar and restaurant in Paramaribo offering cocktails, wines and a casual dining menu in an intimate, relaxed environment.

name: Lees Korean Grill
description: Lee's Korean Grill brings authentic Korean barbecue to Paramaribo. Diners grill their own marinated meats table-side, alongside stews, bibimbap and kimchi.

name: Aquaponics Suriname Leguana Park
description: An aquaponics farm in Paramaribo selling vegetables, seedlings, seeds, fruit trees and tilapia.

name: Leiding 1 Restaurant
description: Leiding 1 Restaurant is a local dining spot in Paramaribo serving traditional Surinamese dishes in a relaxed, community setting. Home-cooked quality at affordable prices.

name: Lely Hills Casino (Pasha Global)
description: A casino at Lelydorp, part of the Pasha Global group.

name: Lili's
description: Lili's is a women's fashion boutique in Paramaribo carrying upmarket clothing, accessories and footwear aimed at a style-conscious clientele. Known for quality pieces and a carefully selected range rather than fast fashion volumes.

name: Lin's Super Market
description: Lins Super Market is a supermarket in Suriname stocking fresh produce, groceries, cold drinks and household products. Known for competitive prices and a practical range that covers everyday shopping needs.

name: Lioness Beauty Effects
description: Lioness Beauty Effects is a waxing and brow specialist in Paramaribo offering waxing, henna brows, lash lift and tint, brow lamination and lip blush. Focused specifically on hair removal and brow shaping rather than a full salon service.

name: Smull Corner - Livorno Snacks
description: A snack and sandwich shop on Botromankiweg in Paramaribo, trading as Smull Corner.

name: Lobby
description: Lobby is a bar and lounge in Paramaribo known for creative cocktails and a more polished atmosphere than most of the city's drinking spots. A good choice for a proper cocktail evening or a stylish pre-dinner drink.

name: Lucky Store
description: Lucky Store is a value retail outlet in Suriname offering a broad range of clothing, household goods and everyday products at competitive prices.

name: Lucky Twins Restaurant
description: Lucky Twins Restaurant is a Chinese-Surinamese eatery in Paramaribo with an extensive menu of Chinese dishes alongside classic Surinamese staples.

name: Luni Gifts
description: A gift and beauty shop on Schietbaanweg in Paramaribo.

name: Luxe Escape Lotus Spa Wellness Beautysalon
description: Luxe Escape Lotus Spa is a full-service spa and beauty salon in Paramaribo offering massages, facials, body treatments and beauty services in a luxurious, serene setting.

name: Luxe & Luminous Beauty Salon
description: A beauty salon in Paramaribo specialising in brow and lash treatments.

name: Surinat Luxury Resort
description: Four bungalows on the grounds of the old La Rencontre plantation in the village of Domburg, about thirty minutes from central Paramaribo. The resort has an outdoor pool, a jacuzzi, a wellness centre, a restaurant, wifi and free bicycles, with a shuttle to Zanderij airport.

name: Luxury Sky Resort
description: A public swimming pool and restaurant in Paramaribo, opened as the second pool of Luxury Sky Residence and open to non-residents.

name: Maharaja Palace
description: Maharaja Palace is an Indian restaurant in Paramaribo serving authentic North Indian cuisine including rich curries, tandoori dishes and freshly baked naan. A regal dining experience.

name: Mantje Bigi Pan Tours
description: Day trips and overnight stays at Bigi Pan, based at Mantje's Lodge.

name: Marchand Notariaat
description: Marchand Notariaat is a notarial practice in Suriname offering notarial services including property transfers, company formations, wills and official documentation.

name: Maretraite Hotel
description: A 14-room hotel on Haydnstraat at Maretraite 3 in Blauwgrond, about four kilometres from the Central Market and close to Maretraite Mall. Each room has a balcony, desk, flat-screen TV, private bathroom, safe, mini fridge and tea and coffee making. Free wifi and free private parking. No pets.

name: Marina Resort Waterland
description: Marina Resort Waterland is a riverside resort near Paramaribo offering boat docking, comfortable accommodation and waterfront dining. Popular with boating enthusiasts and families, it combines marina facilities with resort-style amenities.

name: Marinalex Resort & Waterpark
description: A creek-side resort and waterpark on the J.F. Kennedy Highway at Zanderij. Marinalex has bungalows, two-person rooms, pina huts and group accommodation, plus a large event hall and tall water slides, making it a common choice for family days out and parties.

name: Marowijne Resort
description: A hotel and resort on Juliana Weyneweg in Moengo, Marowijne.

name: Matcha Loft
description: Matcha Loft is a Japanese-inspired café in Paramaribo specialising in matcha drinks, bubble tea and Japanese-fusion light bites. A trendy destination for fans of Asian tea culture.

name: Max N Co.
description: Max N Co is a café and casual dining spot in Paramaribo offering a broad menu of light meals, snacks and beverages in a relaxed, social atmosphere.

name: Maze
description: Maze is a restaurant and bar in Paramaribo with an eclectic menu, a cocktail list and an energetic evening atmosphere. A multi-purpose spot that handles dinner, drinks and late-night socialising depending on what you need from the night.

name: McDonald's Centrum
description: McDonald's Centrum is the main central Paramaribo location of the global fast-food chain, serving burgers, fries, McNuggets and McCafé drinks. Open late, family-friendly and consistently busy. The standard McDonald's experience in central Paramaribo.

name: McDonald's Hermitage Mall
description: McDonald's Hermitage Mall is conveniently located in Paramaribo's Hermitage Mall, offering the full McDonald's menu in a comfortable food court setting.

name: Medische Zending Primary Health Care Suriname
description: Provides primary health care to the interior, running clinics in villages along the rivers where no other medical services exist.

name: Melilew Boutique Hotel
description: A bed and breakfast in the middle of Paramaribo on Henck Arronstraat, five minutes on foot from the Saints Peter and Paul cathedral and ten from Independence Square. Rooms range from doubles to family quads and studio suites, all air conditioned with free wifi. There is an outdoor pool with a separate children's pool, free parking and a 24-hour desk.

name: Menimi Eco Resort
description: A family-run eco resort on an island by the Djemongo rapids in the Upper Suriname River, about an hour upstream by boat from Atjoni. The waterfront cottages were designed and built by the Saramaccan owner, and activities include village tours to Guyaba and New Aurora, night trips to spot caiman, and visits to the Felulasi rapids. Menimi means remember me in Saramaccan.

name: Messias Tours
description: Messias Tours is a Surinamese tour operator offering guided excursions including jungle adventures, river trips and cultural tours. Known for professional guiding and customised itineraries.

name: METS Travel & Tours
description: Suriname's longest-running tour operator, founded in 1962 and focused on sustainable travel. METS runs its own jungle lodges at Palumeu and Awarradam and the Cola Creek recreation resort in the savannah belt, alongside tailor-made trips. There is a sales office on Dr. J.F. Nassylaan in the centre.
address: Doekhieweg Oost 1, Zorg en Hoop, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Mezze Suriname
description: Mezze Suriname is a Mediterranean and Middle Eastern restaurant in Paramaribo serving shared small plates, grilled meats, hummus and dips. A social dining experience celebrating Levantine food culture.

name: Mgr. Aloysius Zichem Sportcentrum (AZS)
description: A sports centre on Prins Hendrikstraat in Paramaribo.

name: Mi Gudu River Cruiser
description: A river cruise operator on the Suriname River, running from Prinsessestraat in Paramaribo.

name: Micki's Palace Noord
description: Micki's Palace Noord is the northern Paramaribo branch of the popular Surinamese restaurant, serving comfort food, local dishes and a broad menu covering everything from simple lunch plates to full dinner meals for families and groups.

name: Micki's Palace Zuid
description: Micki's Palace Zuid is the southern Paramaribo location of the local comfort-food restaurant chain. A popular spot for Surinamese and international dishes in a relaxed setting, suited to family dinners and casual group meals.

name: Mighty Racks
description: Mighty Racks is a BBQ restaurant in Paramaribo specialising in slow-smoked ribs, pulled meats and classic American-style sides. The wood-fired pits and generous portions have made it a firm favourite among meat lovers in Suriname. Great for a filling dinner or a proper weekend feast.

name: Millie's Resort
description: A family recreation resort on the former Plantage Vierkinderen at Republiek, set along the Tawayakoera creek in Para.

name: Mimi Market
description: Mimi Market is a neighbourhood grocery store in Paramaribo offering fresh products, pantry essentials and daily needs at accessible prices.

name: Mingle Paramaribo
description: Mingle Paramaribo is a cocktail lounge in the city with a well-stocked bar and upscale interior design. The menu covers classic and contemporary cocktails. Popular for after-work drinks and evening gatherings, it draws a crowd looking for a polished bar experience in Paramaribo.

name: Mingle Sushi
description: Mingle Sushi is the dedicated sushi counter within the Mingle Paramaribo concept, offering fresh-rolled sushi, poke bowls and Japanese-inspired dishes.

name: Mini Nail Shop
description: Mini Nail Shop is a nail salon in Paramaribo offering manicures, pedicures, nail art and gel nails. A popular spot for affordable, quality nail care services.

name: Miniso Gompertstraat
description: Miniso on Gompertstraat is a branch of the popular Japanese lifestyle brand, offering affordable design-led products including stationery, beauty, toys and homeware.

name: Miniso Hermitage Mall
description: Miniso at Hermitage Mall brings the popular Japanese lifestyle brand's full range of affordable, design-led products to Paramaribo's premier shopping centre.

name: Mirage Casino
description: Mirage Casino is a gaming and entertainment venue in Suriname offering table games, slot machines and casino entertainment.

name: Miss Doll Fit
description: Miss Doll Fit is a women-focused fitness studio in Paramaribo offering engaging group workout classes, dance fitness and body toning sessions in a fun, energetic environment.

name: MJ Lounge & Club
description: A nightclub and lounge on Hofstraat in the centre of Paramaribo, open at weekends.

name: M&N Car Center
description: A car dealership on Belladonnastraat in Paramaribo, well rated by buyers.

name: MN International Centrum
description: MN International Centrum is a Surinamese trading and retail company in central Paramaribo offering a range of international products.

name: MN International Kwatta
description: MN International Kwatta is a branch of the Surinamese retail and trading company, serving the Kwatta district with a range of consumer goods.

name: Moka Coffeebar
description: Moka Coffee Bar is a speciality coffee shop in Paramaribo focused on quality espresso and filter brews, serving artisan coffee alongside homemade pastries.

name: Mokisa Busidataa Osu N.V.
description: Mokisa Busidataa Osu N.V. is a Surinamese business services company offering consulting, administrative and operational support services.

name: Mokisa Wellness
description: Mokisa Wellness is a Surinamese wellness centre offering spa treatments, massages and wellness services. A quiet spot in Suriname for relaxation and body care.

name: Moment's Restaurant
description: Moment's Restaurant is the main dining venue at Oxygen Resort in Paramaribo, set within the resort's garden surroundings. The menu combines international dishes with local Surinamese cuisine, using locally sourced and organic produce where available. Open to both resort guests and walk-in diners.

name: MoMo Korean Fried Chicken
description: The first Korean fried chicken shop in Suriname, known for its sauces. A second branch trades as MoMo Nieuwweer.

name: Mon Plaisir Nursery
description: Mon Plaisir Nursery is a plant nursery in Suriname carrying a wide variety of tropical and ornamental plants suited to Surinamese gardens, balconies and interiors. A calm, green spot to browse and pick up plants, pots and garden essentials.

name: Mondowa Tours
description: Mondowa Tours is a reputable Surinamese tour operator offering eco-tours, jungle expeditions and cultural experiences. Specialising in sustainable tourism into Suriname's pristine interior.

name: Morevans Outlet
description: Morevans Outlet is a furniture and home goods discount store in Paramaribo carrying sofas, dining sets, bedroom furniture and accent pieces at outlet prices. A practical stop for anyone furnishing a home or looking for branded furniture without the full retail price tag.

name: Morgaine Beauty
description: Morgaine Beauty is a beauty salon and cosmetics brand in Suriname offering beauty services alongside its own makeup products.

name: MTC Resort
description: A sports and recreation resort on Grankreekweg at Rijsdijk in Para, about forty kilometres south of Paramaribo and established in 2017. It has a 25-metre pool and a children's pool, a 21-obstacle course, a beach volleyball court, a 1.6 km motocross track, and fifteen shooting bays used for IPSC and clay pigeon shooting.

name: Multi Travel
description: Multi Travel is a full-service travel agency in Paramaribo offering flight tickets, hotel bookings, tour packages and travel insurance. Experienced in both leisure and corporate travel.

name: Muntjes Take Out Juniors Place
description: Muntjes Take-Out / Junior's Place is a local Surinamese take-out restaurant offering quick, affordable meals and snacks for the on-the-go crowd.

name: Murphys Irish Pub
description: Murphy's Irish Pub is Paramaribo's authentic Irish-themed pub, offering Guinness and Irish beers, classic pub food and live sports. A gathering place for expats and football fans in Suriname.

name: Museum Bakkie
description: Museum Bakkie is a unique plantation heritage museum on former coffee plantation Reynsdorp in Commewijne. Set in a beautifully restored colonial building, it offers intimate exhibits on plantation life and Surinamese history.

name: Myrysji Tours Suriname
description: A travel company running trips to Galibi, the interior and the city, and across into French Guiana and Kourou.

name: Naskip Henck Arronstraat
description: Naskip Henck Arronstraat is the flagship location of Suriname's most beloved snack bar chain, serving traditional bara, fari and saoto soup since 1962. Located on Paramaribo's busy Henck Arronstraat.

name: Naskip Latourweg
description: Naskip Latourweg is a branch of Suriname's iconic snack bar chain, serving classic bara, fari and saoto soup in the Latour neighbourhood of Paramaribo.

name: Naskip Gemenelandsweg
description: Naskip Gemenelandsweg brings Suriname's favourite traditional snack bar to the Gemenelandsweg corridor, serving the signature bara, fari and saoto that Naskip is famous for.

name: Naskip Kwatta
description: Naskip Kwatta serves the beloved Surinamese snack bar menu at the corner of Kwattaweg and Van Idsingastraat, a convenient stop in the western Paramaribo area.

name: Naskip Indira Ghandiweg
description: Naskip Indira Ghandiweg is one of the chain's newer locations, offering the same classic Surinamese snack bar experience, covering bara, fari and saoto, in a convenient southern Paramaribo location.

name: Nassy Brouwer College

name: Nassy Brouwer School
description: Nassy-Brouwer School is an educational institution in Paramaribo providing primary and secondary education within Suriname's national school system.

name: Nationaal Vervoer Bedrijf
description: The state bus company, running scheduled public transport in Paramaribo and to the districts.

name: Naughty Angel Beauty Salon
description: A beauty salon in Paramaribo offering waxing and pedicure treatments.

name: Neotropical Butterfly Park
description: A butterfly park at Lelydorp, 30 to 45 minutes from Paramaribo, holding over 150 species. The breeding operation was started by Ewout and Amira Eriks in 1996 and opened to visitors around 2010. Tours follow the full cycle from egg through larva and cocoon to butterfly, and the site also has a gallery of native flora and fauna, a hand-painted 360-degree panorama of Surinamese landscapes upstairs, and a small cafe serving cold drinks and local snacks.

name: New Babunhol River Resort
description: A river resort with its booking office on Industrieweg Zuid in Paramaribo.

name: New Choice Lalla Rookhweg
description: New Choice Lalla Rookhweg is a retail and goods store in Paramaribo offering a variety of products on the popular Lalla Rookhweg commercial strip.

name: New Choice Nickerie
description: New Choice Nickerie is a retail outlet in Suriname's western Nickerie district, offering everyday consumer goods and general merchandise.

name: New Choice Ringweg
description: New Choice Ringweg is a retail and general goods store on Paramaribo's Ringweg, offering a variety of consumer products.

name: New Suriname Dream Cafe
description: New Suriname Dream Café is a modern café in Paramaribo offering a relaxed setting for coffees, light meals and social gatherings. Serving both local and international dishes.

name: Newmont Suriname
description: Operator of the Merian gold mine in the east of the country, one of Suriname's largest foreign investments and a significant employer.

name: Next Club Suriname
description: A nightclub at the Ramada Paramaribo Princess hotel on Kleine Waterstraat.

name: Nickerie Tennis Club
description: A tennis club in Nieuw Nickerie, founded on 1 March 1939 to promote the sport in the district.

name: Night Club Diamond
description: A nightclub on Anton Dragtenweg with resident DJs and live performances, drawing a young crowd. There is a bar and restaurant attached.

name: Nirvana Business Hotel
description: A ten-room business hotel on Keizerstraat, just off Princess Casino and around a kilometre from the centre. Rooms have a seating area, writing desk, microwave, kettle and kitchenware, with free wifi throughout and free private parking. The Central Market and Waterkant are both close by.

name: No Span Eco Tours
description: No Span Eco Tours is a Surinamese eco-tour company offering responsible nature tourism including jungle treks, birdwatching tours and river excursions into Suriname's protected rainforests.

name: Norrii Zushii
description: Norrii Zushii is a sushi and Japanese food spot in Paramaribo known for fresh, creative rolls and Japanese-inspired dishes at an accessible price point.

name: North Fitness Gym
description: North Fitness Gym is a fitness facility in northern Paramaribo providing gym equipment, group classes and personal training services for health-conscious residents.

name: Notariaat Mannes
description: Notariaat Mannes is a Surinamese notarial office providing professional legal documentation, property registration, contracts and notarial certifications.

name: Notariaat Van Dijk
description: Notariaat Van Dijk is a notary office in Paramaribo handling property transfers, company registrations, powers of attorney, wills and other notarial deeds. Qualified notaries providing civil law services to individuals and businesses in Suriname.

description: Nr 1 Spot is a neighbourhood bar and casual dining venue in Paramaribo offering drinks and local Surinamese food in a relaxed, community setting.

name: Numa Cafe
description: Numa Café is a sleek, contemporary café in Paramaribo serving speciality coffees, fresh juices, healthy snacks and light lunches. Popular with young professionals for daytime meetings.

name: N.V. ZING Manufacturing
description: N.V. ZING Manufacturing is a Surinamese production company with a service focus on quality output and client satisfaction. Active in manufacturing and production services for commercial clients in Paramaribo and beyond.

name: Oasis Restaurant
description: Oasis Restaurant is a multi-cuisine spot in Paramaribo with a menu spanning Surinamese, Indonesian and Chinese-Surinamese dishes. Reliable for a filling local lunch or dinner, with a regular clientele and consistent portions.

name: Ochama Amazing
description: Ochama Amazing is a retail outlet in Paramaribo offering a wide variety of imported goods including fashion, accessories and lifestyle products at attractive prices.

name: Ochama Hermitage Mall
description: Ochama at Hermitage Mall stocks imported fashion, accessories and lifestyle products in one of Paramaribo's main shopping centres.

name: Octopus Resort Suriname
description: A day resort on Sumatraweg in Lelydorp with cabanas, apartments, a pool, and a bar and restaurant. It is open from mid-morning until late evening and draws mainly family groups.

name: Office World Hermitage Mall
description: Office World at Hermitage Mall is a stationery and office supplies retailer in Paramaribo carrying paper, printing supplies, office furniture, tech accessories and business essentials. The main go-to for office supply runs in the Hermitage area.

name: Office World Lelydorp
description: Office World Lelydorp brings the chain's office and stationery supplies to the Wanica district: paper, printing, furniture and business essentials for homes and small businesses in and around Lelydorp.

name: Ogi Teppanyaki Sushi Bar
description: OGI Teppanyaki & Sushi Bar is a theatrical Japanese dining experience in Paramaribo featuring live teppanyaki cooking at the table alongside a full sushi bar. A top choice for a lively night out.

name: Okido Tours & Travel
description: Okido Tours & Travel is a Surinamese tour operator and travel agency offering guided day tours, multi-day expeditions and travel services throughout Suriname.

description: Okopipi Tropical Grill is a nature-themed restaurant in Paramaribo serving grilled Surinamese meats and tropical dishes in a lush outdoor setting. Named after Suriname's iconic poison dart frog.

name: Olive Multi Cuisine Restaurant
description: Olive Multi-Cuisine Restaurant is a versatile dining destination in Paramaribo offering dishes from Asian, Indian and Mediterranean cuisines. Known for variety and accommodating large groups.

description: Ondernemershuis is an entrepreneurship support centre in Suriname providing business development resources, training and support for startups and SMEs.

description: One Stop Apotheek & Drugstore is a combined pharmacy and health retail store in Suriname offering medications, supplements, personal care and beauty products under one roof.

name: Optiek All Vision

name: Optiek All Vision Albina
description: Optiek All Vision Albina brings quality optical care to the Marowijne district, offering eye exams, prescription glasses and contact lenses.

name: Optiek All Vision Lelydorp
description: Optiek All Vision Lelydorp offers eye examinations, prescription glasses, contact lenses and a range of frames in the Wanica district. Part of the All Vision optical chain, bringing professional eye care to residents outside central Paramaribo.

name: Optiek All Vision Nickerie
description: Optiek All Vision Nickerie provides professional eye examinations, prescription glasses and contact lenses to Suriname's western Nickerie district. Full optical care without the trip to Paramaribo, with qualified optometrists on site.

name: Optiek Eyeplus
description: A sunglasses and eyewear store on Zonnebloemstraat in Paramaribo, open weekdays from 7am to 3pm and Saturday mornings.

name: Optiek Ligeon
description: An optometrist on Jodenbreestraat in Paramaribo offering eye tests and eyewear.

description: Optiek Marisa is an optical shop and eyewear boutique in Paramaribo offering eye care, prescription glasses, contact lenses and fashionable frames.

description: Optiek Ninon at Hermitage Mall carries eyewear frames and lenses alongside professional optical services in Paramaribo's Hermitage Mall.

description: Overbridge River Resort offers riverside cabin accommodation and water-based activities in a tranquil Surinamese jungle setting. Accessible from Paramaribo, it works well as a weekend getaway combining relaxation with nature.

description: OverDoughsed Suriname is a specialty bakery and dessert brand making artisan doughnuts and baked goods in Paramaribo.

description: Squeezy Hot Pot Restaurant is Paramaribo's go-to for interactive Chinese hot pot dining. Guests choose their own broth, ingredients and sauces for a fun communal experience.

name: Sranan Fowru
description: Sranan Fowru is Suriname's largest fresh chicken wholesaler and retail butcher, supplying whole chickens, fillets, drumsticks and other poultry cuts direct to consumers and small businesses. Multiple locations across Paramaribo with daily fresh stock.

name: Sranan Fowru Boni
description: Sranan Fowru's Bonistraat location provides fresh raw poultry cuts and whole chickens to households and businesses in the Boni area of Paramaribo.

name: Sranan Fowru Combe
description: Sranan Fowru Combe is a fresh chicken butcher outlet serving the Combestraat neighbourhood with a full range of raw poultry products.

name: Sranan Fowru Flu
description: Sranan Fowru Flustraat is a fresh poultry butcher at the Flustraat location, supplying raw chicken cuts, whole birds, fillets, drumsticks and portions, daily to households and small businesses in the area.

name: Sranan Fowru Leiding
description: Sranan Fowru Leiding is a fresh chicken and poultry butcher serving the Leiding district of Paramaribo with daily-fresh cuts, fillets, drumsticks and whole chickens, from Suriname's leading poultry retail chain.

name: Sranan Fowru Lelydorp
description: Sranan Fowru Lelydorp is a fresh chicken butcher outlet serving Wanica district residents with quality raw poultry products.

description: Sranan Fowru Meursweg supplies fresh raw poultry cuts to the Meursweg area, part of Suriname's leading chicken retail chain.

name: Sranan Fowru Tabiki Fowru
description: Sranan Fowru Tabiki Fowru is a fresh poultry outlet supplying raw chicken cuts and whole birds to local customers. Part of Suriname's leading poultry retail chain, with daily fresh stock and consistent quality.

name: Sranan Fowru Tourtonne
description: Sranan Fowru Tourtonnelaan is a fresh chicken butcher serving the Tourtonnelaan area with raw poultry direct from the wholesaler.

name: Sranan Fowru Zinnia
description: Sranan Fowru Zinnia is a neighbourhood fresh chicken outlet offering raw poultry cuts as part of Suriname's leading poultry retail chain.

name: Staatsolie Maatschappij Suriname
description: The state oil and gas company. Onshore production at Tambaredjo, the Tout Lui Faut refinery, power generation, and operator interest in the offshore GranMorgu development in Block 58.
address: Dr. Ir. H.S. Adhinstraat 21, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Stanley's Optics
description: An optician on Zwartenhovenbrugstraat in Paramaribo, selling glasses and eyewear.

name: STAS International
description: A strategic communication and branding agency in Paramaribo, working across strategy and creative for private sector, government and NGO clients, and running promotional events, product launches and conferences. Founded and led by Karin Refos, with Kenzo Soemodihardjo as creative director. Its recent work includes the communication programme for the Paramaribo Urban Rehabilitation Program.

name: Stedin Speciaalslagerij
description: A specialist butcher on Franchepanestraat in Paramaribo, selling fresh and prepared meats.

name: Steps Domineestraat
description: Steps Domineestraat brings the popular footwear brand to central Paramaribo's shopping street, offering trendy affordable shoes and accessories.

name: Steps Hermitage Mall
description: Steps at Hermitage Mall is a footwear and accessories chain with affordable, trendy shoes and sandals. A go-to for everyday fashion at accessible price points.

name: Steps Noord
description: Steps Noord serves the northern Paramaribo area with the popular Steps footwear range of affordable, fashionable shoes for the whole family.

name: Steps Wanica
description: Steps Wanica brings the popular footwear chain to the Wanica district, offering affordable shoes and accessories for everyday wear.

name: Sthephany Skincare
description: Sthephany Skincare is a Surinamese skincare brand producing products formulated for tropical climates and darker skin tones. The range covers face care, body care and targeted treatments, available through local retailers and online.

name: Stichting Lodgeholders Boven-Suriname (LBS)
description: A non-profit promoting and developing sustainable eco-tourism in the Upper Suriname river area, representing the lodge owners there.

name: Openluchtmuseum Fort Nieuw-Amsterdam
description: An open-air museum inside the walls of Fort Nieuw-Amsterdam, at the point where the Suriname and Commewijne rivers meet. The fort was built between 1734 and 1747 and the museum opened in 1968. A permanent exhibition on Anton de Kom, made with the Dutch Open-Air Museum, opened in March 2025.

name: Stichting Shiatsu Massage
description: Stichting Shiatsu Massage is a Paramaribo foundation providing shiatsu massage services through therapists who are visually impaired. The organisation trains visually impaired individuals as massage therapists to create employment opportunities. Therapists have been trained over more than 13 years in shiatsu technique and application.

name: Stichting Surinaams Museum
description: Stichting Surinaams Museum manages Fort Zeelandia and Suriname's national museum collection, preserving and presenting the country's rich colonial and multicultural heritage through exhibitions and heritage programmes.

name: Upper-Suriname (Foundation of Saramaccan Lodgeholders)
description: A community organisation representing Saramaccan lodge owners on the Upper Suriname River.

name: Zwembad Parima
description: A public swimming pool in Paramaribo, open to all ages with morning and afternoon sessions.

name: STINASU - Stichting Natuurbehoud Suriname
description: The Foundation for Nature Conservation in Suriname, set up in 1969 to handle education and visitor access in the protected areas. It books accommodation at Brownsberg and Raleighvallen.

name: Ston Eiland Resort
description: A resort on a peninsula in the Brokopondo reservoir at the foot of the Brownsberg, reached by dirt road from Brownsweg roughly 120 km south of Paramaribo. Cabins have beds and fans, and there is a restaurant and a boat dock for trips onto the lake, where drowned tree trunks still break the surface. Swimming, fishing and canoeing are the main draws.

name: Store4u
description: Store4U is a multi-category retail shop in Paramaribo selling clothing, electronics, household goods and general merchandise. Practical for everyday shopping across several product categories at accessible prices.

name: Stukaderen in Nederland
description: Stukaderen in Nederland is a Surinamese plastering and finishing contractor specialising in interior wall and ceiling work. Services cover both residential and commercial projects, with experience in Dutch construction standards for Surinamese clients working across both markets.

name: STVS
description: Surinaamse Televisie Stichting, the state broadcaster.

name: Subway (Lalla Rookhweg)
description: Subway in Paramaribo serves made-to-order sandwiches, wraps and salads with your choice of bread, fillings and toppings. The Suriname locations follow the standard Subway format, a quick, customisable option for lunch or a light meal in the city.

name: Subway (Jozef Israëlsstraat)
description: Subway on Jozef Israëlsstraat is one of Paramaribo's convenient sub sandwich locations, offering freshly made-to-order subs, wraps and salads with a full range of toppings.

name: Subway (Kwattaweg)
description: Subway on Kwattaweg brings the build-your-own sandwich experience to the Kwatta area of Paramaribo, serving freshly made subs, salads and wraps.

name: Sugar
description: Sugar is a dessert café and sweet shop in Paramaribo offering cakes, cupcakes, ice cream and a variety of sugary treats. A feel-good destination for dessert lovers.

name: Sun Ice
description: Sun Ice is an ice cream and frozen treats shop in Paramaribo with a variety of flavours and frozen desserts. A refreshing stop in Suriname's tropical heat.

name: Sun Smile Hotel & Apartments
description: A hotel and apartment property on Jacabastraat, about 3.5 km from the Central Market and 3 km from the Surinaams Museum. There is a 24-hour front desk, a terrace and free wifi, some rooms have balconies, and breakfast is served each morning either continental or a la carte.

name: Sundae Bliss
description: An ice cream shop in Shafantur Mall on Verlengde Gemenelandsweg. Open Tuesday to Saturday from midday to 8pm and Sunday from 4pm, closed Mondays.
address: Verlengde Gemenelandsweg 147, unit 115-116, Shafantur Mall, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Supply Solutions Limited Suriname
description: Supply Solutions Limited is a Surinamese procurement and supply chain company providing sourcing, logistics and supply services for businesses across sectors.

name: Suran Adventures Tours & Travel
description: Suran Adventures Tours & Travel is a Surinamese adventure tour operator offering jungle treks, river expeditions, cultural tours and travel agency services across Suriname.

name: Suraniyat
description: Suraniyat is a Surinamese fashion house producing clothing rooted in traditional craft techniques and cultural motifs. The brand works with artisan methods and cultural expression, positioned between fashion and wearable craft, with a small-batch production approach.

name: Surgoed Makelaardij
description: Surgoed Makelaardij is a reputable Surinamese real estate agency specialising in property sales, appraisals and rental management. Known for transparent, professional service.

name: Surinaamsche Waterleiding Maatschappij
description: Surinaamsche Waterleiding Maatschappij (SWM) is Suriname's national water supply company, responsible for treating and distributing clean drinking water across Paramaribo and surrounding districts.

name: Surinaamse Badminton Bond (SuBaBo)
description: The official badminton association for Suriname.

name: Surinaamse Postspaarbank
description: State savings bank offering savings accounts, loans and payment services, with branches across the districts.

name: Surinam Airways
description: Surinam Airways is the national airline of Suriname, operating scheduled flights connecting Paramaribo to destinations across the Caribbean, South America and Europe, including direct services to Amsterdam. The primary carrier for international travel to and from Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport.

name: SHATA - Suriname Hospitality and Tourism Association
description: The trade body for Suriname's tourism and hospitality sector, founded in 2012. SHATA represents members nationally and internationally, builds partnerships with government and industry, and feeds policy recommendations into tourism development.

name: Suriname Hotel Association
description: The national hotel association of Suriname.

name: Suriname Princess Casino
description: Suriname Princess Casino is a gaming and entertainment complex offering table games, slot machines, hotel accommodation and dining in Paramaribo.

name: Suriname Tuk Tuk Tours
description: Guided tuk-tuk tours around Paramaribo and its surroundings, covering the historic quarter and running out to the former Peperpot plantation.

name: Suriname Tulip Hotel
description: A budget hotel on the Waterkant, about 200 metres from the Central Market and within walking distance of Fort Zeelandia, the Neveh Shalom synagogue and the Saints Peter and Paul cathedral. Rooms are air conditioned with a TV and private bathroom, and there is a restaurant, a shuttle service and a light continental breakfast.

name: Suriname Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A rescue and rehabilitation centre for native wildlife, founded by Matthijs and Valeska Kuijpers who moved to Suriname in 2024. Unlike most shelters it takes a wide range of species, from capuchin monkeys and parrots to boas and sloths. Injured, orphaned and confiscated animals get medical care and, where possible, release back to the wild. The site covers around 100 hectares of forest with creeks running through it, and takes eco-volunteers on stays from one week.

name: Surpost
description: The national postal service, handling mail, parcels and postal financial services across the districts.

name: Sushi-Ya
description: Sushi Ya is a sushi restaurant in Paramaribo serving Japanese-style rolls, sashimi and nigiri with some local Surinamese twists on ingredients. One of the more established sushi spots in the capital, popular for lunch and dinner with a menu suited to both sushi regulars and beginners.

name: Sutopia Resort
description: A small aparthotel on Weg naar Peperpot in Meerzorg, set on the Suriname River among native planting. Eight individually decorated rooms have kitchenettes and private patios, and there is an outdoor pool, garden and bar. Peperpot Nature Park and Jodensavanne are both within about fifteen minutes drive.

name: Sweet Tooth Pastries
description: Sweet Tooth Pastries is a Paramaribo bakery making custom celebration cakes, cupcakes and artisan pastries to order for birthdays, weddings and corporate events. The walk-in display carries fresh daily bakes: decorated layer cakes, flavoured cupcakes and seasonal pastries.

name: Sweetheart Hermitage Mall
description: Sweetheart at Hermitage Mall is a candy and confectionery shop carrying sweets, chocolates, imported snacks and novelty treats across a well-stocked floor in one of Paramaribo's main shopping centres. Popular for birthday gifts, party supplies and satisfying any sweet craving.

name: Sweetheart IMS
description: Sweetheart IMS is a candy and confectionery shop at the International Mall of Suriname stocking sweets, chocolates, lollipops and imported treats. A favourite for pick-and-mix and packaged gifts, handy for party bags and last-minute presents.

name: Sweetie Coffee
description: Sweetie Coffee is a sweet-focused café in Paramaribo serving flavoured coffees, milkshakes, desserts and pastries. A playful café popular with younger visitors.

name: Sweets & Brews by Nass
description: A cafeteria on Mahonylaan serving coffee and sweet food, open Monday to Saturday from 8am to 3pm.

name: Switi Momenti Candles & Crafts
description: Switi Momenti is a Surinamese candle and crafts brand making scented handmade candles and artisan gift products. A good source for personal treats or Surinamese-made gifts.

name: Talking Prints Concept Store
description: Talking Prints is a Surinamese concept store and clothing brand printing original artwork and cultural motifs onto tees, hoodies and accessories. Based in Paramaribo, the brand draws on Surinamese heritage, drawing on Maroon, Creole, Hindustani and Javanese imagery, and works with local artists.

name: Talula
description: Talula is a boutique in Paramaribo offering a curated selection of clothing, accessories and lifestyle items, known for its stylish interior and personal service.

name: Taman Indah Resort
description: Taman Indah Resort is a peaceful resort near Paramaribo featuring lush gardens, a pool and comfortable bungalows. The property draws on Indonesian-inspired design and offers a relaxed atmosphere ideal for families and couples.

name: Tapauku Terras
description: Tapauku Terras is an outdoor terrace bar and restaurant in Paramaribo offering a relaxed open-air atmosphere, drinks and light bites with a Surinamese spirit.

name: Tastelicious
description: Tastelicious is a casual restaurant and food concept in Paramaribo serving local Surinamese-inspired dishes and flavourful street food.

name: Tasty Fresh Food Coffee Bar
description: Tasty Fresh Food & Coffee Bar is a health-conscious café in Paramaribo offering fresh juices, smoothies, sandwiches and coffee. A bright, energising spot for a healthy start.

name: TBL Cinemas
description: TBL Cinemas is Suriname's largest cinema chain, with multi-screen locations across Paramaribo showing the latest Hollywood releases, international films and occasional local productions. Air-conditioned theatres with comfortable seating make it the top choice for a night out at the movies in the capital.

name: Teasee
description: Teasee is a bubble tea and Asian drinks cafe in Paramaribo serving milk teas, fruit teas and creative drinks. A fun, photogenic spot for tea lovers.

name: Telesur Centrum
description: Telesur Centrum is the main city-centre branch of Suriname's national telecommunications provider, offering landline, internet, mobile and digital services.

name: Telesur Latour
description: Telesur Latour is a branch of Suriname's national telecom provider serving the Latour district with internet, mobile and landline services.

name: Telesur Lelydorp
description: Telesur Lelydorp provides Suriname's national telecom services to the Wanica district, offering internet, mobile and landline subscriptions.

name: Telesur Nickerie
description: Telesur Nickerie serves the western Nickerie district with national telecom services including internet, mobile and landline products.

name: Telesur Noord
description: Telesur Noord is a northern Paramaribo branch of Suriname's national telecommunications provider, offering internet, mobile and digital services.

name: Telesur Telecommunicatie Museum
description: A telecommunications museum run by Telesur, covering the history of the network in Suriname.

name: Telesur Zonnebloemstraat
description: Telesur Zonnebloemstraat provides Suriname's national telecom services from a Paramaribo branch, offering internet, mobile and landline connectivity.

name: The Aerial Yoga Studio
description: The Aerial Yoga Studio is Suriname's dedicated aerial yoga facility, offering classes in aerial yoga, silks and anti-gravity fitness. A unique and empowering fitness experience.

name: The Ark Hotel
description: A small hotel on Anton Dragtenweg in Paramaribo. Rooms are air conditioned and non-smoking, with room service and wifi. The restaurant serves regional and European dishes, there is a bar, and breakfast can be brought to the room on request. Airport and shuttle transfers are available at extra cost.

name: The Bakery House
description: The Bakery House is an artisan bakery in Paramaribo turning out fresh bread, pastries, cakes and savoury baked goods daily. Known for consistent quality and a proper bakery feel, it draws a steady morning crowd for breakfast pastries and coffee.

name: The Basement Barbershop
description: The Basement Barbershop is a men's grooming spot in Paramaribo offering precision haircuts, fades, beard trims and classic barbershop services.

name: The Beauty Bar
description: The Beauty Bar is a hair and beauty salon in Paramaribo offering blowouts, hair extensions, nail services, lashes and skin treatments. Known for quality hair work, particularly blowouts and colour, with a clientele that books ahead for the popular stylists.

name: The Beauty Bar North
description: The Beauty Bar North is the northern Paramaribo branch of the local hair and beauty salon group, offering blowouts, extensions, nail treatments and lash services. Same quality focus as the main location, more conveniently positioned for clients north of the city centre.

name: The Beauty Bar South
description: The Beauty Bar South serves southern Paramaribo with the same hair styling, nail and beauty treatment menu as the other branches. Blowouts, extensions and nail services available, with booking recommended for peak times.

name: The Caterpillar Montessorischool
description: An education institute on Martiniquestraat offering curriculum development support and homeschool curriculum setup.

name: The Coffee Box
description: The Coffee Box is a café and grill in Paramaribo combining specialty coffee with a food menu of grilled dishes, sandwiches and breakfast plates. A solid all-day option that works as well for a morning coffee as it does for a proper sit-down lunch.

name: The Coffee Box North
description: The Coffee Box North is the northern Paramaribo branch of the popular specialty coffee brand, serving expertly brewed coffees and snacks.

name: The Coffee Hobbyist
description: The Coffee Hobbyist is a specialty coffee shop in Paramaribo that takes brewing seriously. Single-origin beans, manual brewing methods and trained baristas define the offer. The place for proper filter coffee or an espresso made the right way, with a quieter atmosphere than the bigger café chains.

name: The Freelance Scout
description: The Freelance Scout is a Surinamese platform and consultancy connecting businesses with freelance professionals across creative, tech and business disciplines.

name: The Girl House
description: The Girl House is a nail studio in Paramaribo offering manicures, pedicures, nail art and personal-care treatments in a relaxed, social setting.

name: The Golden Truly Hotel
description: The Golden Truly Hotel & Casino is a centrally located Paramaribo hotel offering rooms, a casino, bar and meeting facilities. Positioned for business travellers and visitors who want city-centre access with on-site entertainment.

name: The House of Beauty
description: The House of Beauty is a beauty salon in Munster, Paramaribo offering facials, waxing, hair care, full-body massage, manicures, pedicures and body scrubs. A full-service salon covering most beauty treatment needs in one location.

name: The Laundry Spot
description: The Laundry Spot is a full-service laundry and dry cleaning facility in Paramaribo offering wash-and-fold, dry cleaning and express laundry services.

name: The Maillard Cafe
description: The Maillard Café is a sophisticated café and patisserie in Paramaribo serving artisan pastries, specialty coffees and creative brunch dishes.

name: The Nail House
description: The Nail House is a nail salon in Paramaribo offering gel, acrylic, dip powder and nail art services alongside manicures and pedicures. A focused nail-only setup with trained technicians and a proper range of finishes and designs.

name: The Old Attic
description: The Old Attic is a gift and collectibles shop in Paramaribo carrying accessories, jewellery, anime merchandise, vintage collectables and novelty items. The kind of shop where you browse longer than planned. Popular with students and collectors.

name: The Old Garage
description: The Old Garage is a bar and casual dining spot in Paramaribo set inside a converted industrial space, with exposed brick, cold beers and a laid-back crowd. Known for grilled snacks, cocktails and live music nights, it's one of the city's more characterful after-work and weekend hangouts.

name: The Perfume Spot
description: The Perfume Spot is a fragrance boutique in Paramaribo stocking perfumes, colognes and body mists from local and international brands. In-store testers and staff who know the range make it easy to match scents to your preference.

name: The Solution Property Management
description: The Solution Property Management provides professional property management and maintenance services in Paramaribo, handling rentals, tenant relations and facility management.

name: Suriname Tourism Board
description: Suriname's national tourism body, promoting the country's cultures, interior and people to visitors.

name: The Sweetest Thing
description: The Sweetest Thing is a dessert and pastry brand in Suriname offering custom cakes, cupcakes and sweet gifts for all occasions.

name: The Uma Store
description: The Uma Store is a retail space in Suriname selling artisan goods, local food specialties and handmade products that reflect the country's cultural diversity. The store operates with a focus on sustainability and direct support for local producers and artisans. A good option for visitors looking for authentic Surinamese products beyond standard tourist goods.

name: The Warehouse Shop
description: The Warehouse Shop is a large-format general merchandise retailer in Suriname carrying household goods, cleaning products, groceries and everyday essentials at competitive prices. A practical bulk-buy destination for families and small businesses stocking up on the basics.

name: The Waxing Booth and More by SG
description: The Waxing Booth is a waxing specialist salon in Paramaribo focused entirely on hair removal services: body waxing, facial waxing, brow shaping and related treatments. A clean, professional setup with experienced therapists and proper hygiene standards.

name: The WonderLab Su
description: The Wonderlab is a beauty and skincare studio in Paramaribo offering advanced aesthetic treatments, facials and skincare consultations. Known for science-backed beauty solutions.

name: Theater Thalia
description: Theater Thalia is Paramaribo's main performing arts venue, staging theatre productions, live music, dance performances and comedy shows year-round in a beautifully preserved colonial building. Home to both local productions and visiting international acts. Check the schedule before visiting.

name: Thermen Hermitage Turkish Bath & Beautycenter
description: Thermen Hermitage is a Turkish bath and beauty centre in Paramaribo offering hammam steam baths, body treatments, massages and beauty services. A luxurious wellness experience inspired by traditional Turkish bathing culture.

name: Three Little Beans
description: Three Little Beans is a specialty coffee shop and café in Paramaribo focused on artisan coffee, freshly baked goods and a warm, community-focused atmosphere.

name: Tian You Paranam
description: A bubble tea shop at La Vigilantia on the Meursweg in Para.

name: Tianyou Aquafun
description: Tianyou AquaFun is a water park and aquatic recreation centre in Paramaribo offering pools, water slides and family entertainment. A popular destination for cooling off in Suriname's tropical heat.

name: Timeless Barber and Nail Shop
description: Timeless Barber and Nail Shop in Paramaribo offers haircuts, beard shaves, manicures and pedicures under one roof. The combination of barbershop and nail services makes it a practical stop for clients who want grooming and nail care in a single visit.
address: Jan Besar Sarno Rebostraat #10, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Tiny House Tropical Appartment
description: Tiny House Tropical Apartment offers a compact, stylishly designed holiday apartment in Paramaribo. Ideal for solo travellers and couples, the property combines modern amenities with tropical character at an affordable nightly rate.

name: Tio Boto Eco Resort
description: Tio Boto Eco Resort is a riverside eco-lodge in Suriname's interior, built and managed by the local Maroon community. Guests can enjoy guided jungle treks, river swimming, traditional Maroon crafts and authentic Surinamese hospitality.

name: Tipsy Bar Lounge
description: Tipsy Bar & Lounge is a nightlife venue in Paramaribo with creative cocktails, a relaxed lounge atmosphere and regular DJ events.

name: Tirzahs Patisserie
description: Tirzah's Patisserie is an artisan pastry shop in Paramaribo known for beautifully crafted celebration cakes, tarts and desserts made to order. The go-to for weddings and birthdays when presentation matters as much as taste.

name: Tomahawk Outdoor Adventures
description: Tomahawk is a Suriname outdoor shop selling gear, equipment and accessories for outdoor enthusiasts. Multiple locations across Paramaribo.

name: Tomahawk Outdoor Adventures Hermitage
description: Tomahawk at Hermitage Mall is an outdoor shop selling gear and equipment for outdoor activities. Part of the Tomahawk chain in Suriname.

name: Tomahawk Outdoor Adventures IMS
description: Tomahawk at the International Mall of Suriname offers outdoor gear, equipment and accessories. Part of the Tomahawk chain across Paramaribo.

name: Tomahawk Outdoor Adventures Lelydorp
description: Tomahawk in Lelydorp is an outdoor shop near Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport, selling gear and equipment for outdoor enthusiasts.

name: Topslager Stolk
description: Topslager Stolk is a premium butcher shop in Suriname offering high-quality fresh meats, speciality cuts and prepared meat products.

name: Topsport
description: Topsport is a fitness and sports club in Paramaribo offering gym facilities, group exercise classes and sporting activities. Suited to both competitive athletes and recreational fitness enthusiasts.

name: Torarica Resort
description: Torarica Resort is a large riverfront resort complex in Paramaribo with pools, a casino, multiple dining outlets, sports facilities and a spa. One of the longest-established resort properties in Suriname, popular for weekend stays, events and as a leisure base for business travellers.

name: Tori Oso
description: Tori Oso, Sranan for story house, is a cafe-restaurant on Fred Derbystraat in Paramaribo, open since 1991. The kitchen is built around burgers, with pasta nights, snacks and cocktails alongside. As much a place to sit, drink and talk as to eat. Closed Mondays.

name: Touch Of Heaven Wellness
description: Touch of Heaven Wellness is a spa and wellness retreat in Suriname offering massages, beauty treatments and wellness therapies in Suriname.

name: Tourbox Suriname
description: A tour operator working out of the Kleine Waterstraat bus square by 't Vat, offering plantation and history trips, dolphin and caiman spotting, canoe trips, mountain bike tours with jungle overnights, and longer runs into the interior by bus, boat or light aircraft.

name: Tout Tout Petit
description: Tout Tout Petit is a French-inspired bakery in Paramaribo with fresh daily bakes, croissants, pastries and custom cakes. A neighbourhood favourite for morning coffee and weekend treats.

name: Toys N More
description: Toys N More is a toy and games shop in Suriname stocking action figures, board games, educational sets, puzzles, remote-control vehicles and gifts for children of all ages. A reliable go-to for birthday shopping and holiday gifts across Paramaribo, with friendly staff who can help find the right present.

name: Tran Elite Hotel Apartments
description: A hotel and apartment property on Jacques Gompertstraat in Paramaribo Noord, a couple of minutes from Maretraite Mall and about ten from Palmentuin. There is a 24-hour front desk, laundry and dry cleaning, free self parking and an airport shuttle at extra cost.

name: Tranquil At Mamba Republiek
description: Tranquil at Mamba Republiek is a wellness and relaxation centre offering spa treatments and massage therapy in a stylish Paramaribo setting.

name: Tranquil Massage
description: Tranquil Massage is a professional massage therapy studio in Paramaribo offering Swedish, deep tissue and relaxation massages. Known for skilled therapists and a calm, welcoming environment.

name: Travel The Guianas
description: A tour agency on Parijsstraat in Paramaribo specialising in trips across all three Guianas - Suriname, Guyana and French Guiana.

name: Triple Security Unit
description: Triple Security Unit offers professional, reliable, and affordable security services in Suriname.

name: Trizzle's Beauty Spot
description: A beauty and personal care salon on Van Idsingastraat in Paramaribo.

name: Tropa de Elite Paintball
description: A paintball venue in Suriname, run alongside the Tropa de Elite paintball team. One of the few places in the country set up for the sport.

name: Tropicana Hotel Casino
description: Tropicana Hotel & Casino is a full-service hotel and entertainment complex in Paramaribo. Featuring a casino, hotel rooms, restaurant and bar, it is a lively option for guests seeking both accommodation and nightlife entertainment.

name: Trustbank Amanah
description: Suriname's Islamic bank, offering interest-free banking products to retail and business customers.

name: Tsw Group
description: TSW Group is a Surinamese conglomerate offering services across multiple sectors including logistics, trading and business services.

name: Tucan Resort and Spa
description: Tucan Resort & Spa is a wellness-focused resort near Paramaribo offering spa treatments, a pool and comfortable bungalow lodging in a lush, tranquil setting, suited to relaxation and short retreats near Paramaribo.

name: Tulip Cafeteria
description: A cafeteria on Tourtonnelaan in Paramaribo.

name: Tulip Supermarket
description: Tulip Supermarket is a supermarket chain in Suriname stocking fresh produce, groceries, household essentials and a solid selection of international products. Part of the Amazone Retail group, with multiple locations across Paramaribo and the interior.

name: Twenty4 Hostel
description: Paramaribo's first and only hostel, on Jessurunstraat, aimed at backpackers and independent travellers. It has private rooms and shared dorms with air conditioning or fans, a shared kitchen, garden, sun terrace and lounge, a 24-hour desk, shuttle service and bike hire. Adults only. The Central Market, the cathedral and the Waterkant are all close by.

name: Twins Pizza Burgers
description: Twins Pizza & Burgers is a fast-food spot in Paramaribo serving affordable pizzas and juicy burgers. Quick service and satisfying portions.

name: Typing Nomad N.V.
description: Typing Nomad N.V. is a digital nomad and remote work support company in Suriname, offering co-working facilities and services for location-independent professionals.

name: U S Bakery
description: U.S. Bakery is a bakery in Paramaribo offering fresh bread, Surinamese pastries, savoury snacks and celebration cakes. A staple trusted by Paramaribo households.

name: Uitkijk Riverlounge Cafe
description: Uitkijk Riverlounge Café offers beautiful views of the Suriname River alongside coffee, cocktails and light meals in a relaxed open-air setting. One of Paramaribo's most atmospheric spots.

name: Unique Package Plan
description: A Paramaribo travel business putting together fully arranged trips within Suriname and abroad.

name: Unlimited Suriname Tours
description: Unlimited Suriname Tours runs guided tours into Suriname's interior, covering rainforest, river and indigenous village experiences. Based in Paramaribo, the company handles logistics for multi-day jungle trips and day excursions for groups and individual travellers.

name: Unlock Nature

It sits close to the Galibi Nature Reserve, and the main draw is the green and leatherback turtle nesting season, alongside birdwatching, fishing and visits to the Kalina villages.

description: VCM Slagerij Centrum is a central Paramaribo butcher offering quality fresh meats and cold cuts in central Paramaribo.

description: VCM Slagerij on Verlengde Gemenelandsweg is a convenient branch of the quality Surinamese butcher chain serving the Gemenelandsweg area.

name: Vifa Trading
description: Vifa Trading is a Surinamese importer and retailer of consumer electronics, household appliances and general merchandise. Known for competitive pricing and a broad product range.

name: Villa Famiri
description: Villa Famiri is a boutique hotel in Paramaribo with a warm, family atmosphere. Centrally located, it offers cosy rooms, a garden and personalised service. A favourite among independent travellers and repeat visitors to Suriname.

name: Villa Zapakara
description: Villa Zapakara is a private villa retreat near Paramaribo, offering exclusive accommodation surrounded by tropical gardens. Suitable for small groups and special occasions, it provides a secluded home base for exploring Suriname.

name: Village Park 33
description: A private beach resort at Cabendadorp in Para, hired out as a private venue.

name: Villas Paramaribo
description: Villas Paramaribo offers a collection of self-catering villas and apartments for short and long-term stays in Suriname's capital. With full facilities and a residential feel, the property appeals to families and extended-stay business travellers.

name: Vincent Supermarket
description: Vincent Supermarket is a trusted neighbourhood supermarket in Suriname, providing fresh produce, groceries and everyday household items to the local community.

name: Viva Mexico
description: Viva Mexico is a Mexican restaurant and bar in Paramaribo serving tacos, burritos, nachos and classic Mexican dishes alongside margaritas and Latin cocktails.

name: Surinaamse Volkscredietbank
description: State-owned bank focused on small business and consumer credit.

name: VSH United
description: N.V. Verenigde Surinaamse Holdingmaatschappij. A diversified holding with interests in food, shipping, industrial supply, real estate and financial services.

name: Waldos Worldwide Travel Service
description: Waldo's Worldwide Travel Service is a Paramaribo travel agency handling international flight bookings, hotel reservations, visa assistance and holiday packages. Suited to both leisure travellers and business clients needing end-to-end trip planning from Suriname.

name: Warsha N.V.
description: A building materials supplier on Kwattaweg in Paramaribo.

name: Warung Blauwtjie
description: A Javanese warung in Suriname serving breakfast and brunch, with a large local following.

name: Warung Oetomo
description: A Javanese food stand at Verlengde Welgedacht C, serving traditional dishes to take away.

name: Warung Resa Centrum
description: Warung Resa Centrum is a traditional Javanese-Surinamese warung in central Paramaribo serving authentic Indonesian-influenced dishes. A cultural dining experience reflecting Suriname's Javanese heritage.

name: Warung Soepy Ann
description: Warung Soepy Ann is a traditional Surinamese eatery known for home-style cooking and beloved local dishes. A community favourite for affordable, authentic Surinamese food.

name: Waterland Suites
description: Waterland Suites is a small hotel in the Zorg en Hoop neighbourhood of Paramaribo offering two- and four-person rooms and self-contained residences. The property suits both short stays and longer visits, and caters to business travellers and tourists who prefer a quieter base outside the city centre.

name: Waterproof Tours Suriname
description: A tour operator best known for its Sunset & Dolphins boat trip on the Suriname River, a three-hour late-afternoon cruise that stops at a former plantation for a snack before turning back for the sunset. Waterproof also runs sea turtle trips and cultural tours to Moengo.

name: Wayfinders Exclusive N.V.
description: Wayfinders Exclusive is a car rental and ATV tour operator in Suriname, offering vehicle hire for independent travel alongside guided off-road ATV tours into Suriname's interior. A practical choice for travellers who want to explore beyond Paramaribo at their own pace.

name: Welink Real Estate
description: Welink Real Estate is a Paramaribo property agency offering residential and commercial property sales, rentals and investment consulting.

name: Wing Hung Cake Shop
description: Wing Hung is a long-running Chinese-Surinamese bakery selling cakes, pastries and traditional baked goods. Families across Paramaribo have been stopping by for generations.

name: Wolly's Zorg & Hoop
description: Wollys is a Surinamese fast-food chain with hot dogs, burgers and classic Surinamese fast food. A local brand with multiple locations across Paramaribo.

name: Wolly's Latourweg
description: Wollys (2nd location) brings the popular Surinamese hot dog and fast-food brand to another area of Paramaribo, continuing the tradition of affordable, tasty local fast food.

name: Wolly's Steenbakkerijstraat
description: Wollys (3rd location) extends the beloved Surinamese fast-food brand's reach, serving classic hot dogs and burgers at a third convenient Paramaribo location.

name: Woodwonders Suriname
description: Wood Wonders is a Surinamese wood products company producing handmade items from local tropical hardwoods: furniture, decorative pieces and custom woodwork. A family business with over 30 years in the trade, combining traditional craft with sustainably sourced Surinamese timber.

name: Wow Plus
description: Wow Plus is a retail and convenience store in Suriname offering a range of consumer products, snacks and everyday essentials.

name: X Avenue
description: X-Avenue is a fashion and lifestyle store in Paramaribo carrying streetwear, accessories and current apparel.

name: Yasmin Luxury Resort
description: A family-oriented resort on Verlengde Jacques Gompertstraat in Paramaribo. Rooms are air conditioned with kitchenettes, balconies, private bathrooms and free wifi. Facilities include an indoor pool, hot tub, fitness room, sun terrace, garden and outdoor play area, and the restaurant serves a halal breakfast alongside brunch, lunch and dinner.
address: Julius Anton de Komstraat 89, Surivillage 4, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Ying Hao Beautyshop
description: Ying Hao Beauty Shop is a beauty and cosmetics retailer in Paramaribo carrying cosmetics, hair-care products and beauty accessories.

description: Our centre is focused on happiness, growth and realization. If there is a mall for food and clothes, there must certainly be a place for you to feel at ease, to explore freedom and experience happiness.

description: Yokohama Trading is a Surinamese trading company offering electronics, appliances and general consumer goods. Known for a diverse catalogue and wholesale and retail supply.

name: Young Engineers
description: Young Engineers is an educational programme in Suriname teaching STEM and engineering principles to children through fun, hands-on activities with building toys and technology.

name: Zeedijk Resort Nickerie
description: A guesthouse on Van Idsingaweg in Nieuw Nickerie, roughly 2 km from the town centre and facing the sea dike. Rooms are air-conditioned with kitchenettes and private bathrooms, and the property has a garden, terraces with sea views, free parking and bicycles for guests.

name: Zeelandia Suites
description: Zeelandia Suites is a hotel in Paramaribo established in March 1997, located near the city's commercial centre. Accommodation is in self-contained suites with a bedroom, living room, bathroom and balcony or terrace. Restaurants, cafes, museums and other city amenities are within walking distance.

name: Zeepfabriek JOAB
description: Zeepfabriek Joab is a Surinamese family-owned soap manufacturer with over 30 years of experience producing natural, handmade eco-friendly soaps. Products are made from local ingredients and sold both locally and to the export market.

name: Zeg Ijsje
description: Zeg IJsje is an ice cream and dessert shop in Paramaribo serving fresh tropical flavours and classic scoops. A sweet stop for families across the city.

name: Zenobia Bottling Company
description: Zenobia Bottling Company is a Surinamese beverage manufacturer producing local soft drinks and beverages. A proudly local brand supplying refreshments across Suriname.

name: Zin Resort
description: A public swimming pool, guesthouse and bar on Van Roseveltkade in Paramaribo, about 3 km from the centre. The pool is open to day visitors.

name: Zus & Zo Cafe
description: Zus & Zo is a cafe in Paramaribo serving Caribbean and international fusion cuisine, with vegetarian and vegan options on the menu. Open daily, it draws a consistent mix of locals and visitors. Known for a friendly atmosphere and a varied menu that goes beyond standard cafe fare.

name: Zwemschool Tukunari
description: A swimming school on Mr. Eduard J. Brumastraat in Paramaribo, teaching all ages.
